purpose: Native, inspectable Stack Lab authority surface for the Pantheon macOS app. It projects the canonical Go doctor report and routes incomplete authority into Ma'at evidence without creating a second registry or shell transcript.

prohibited: Swift cannot recreate registry or origin authority
Swift cannot treat unreadable remote state as clean
the native surface cannot mutate a wing, pin, roster, release, or remote registry

inputs: canonical sirsi stacklab doctor JSON report
outputs: in-context project selection before any repository read
Ma'at evidence route for unresolved findings
explicit handoff to Ma'at's selected-project release-contract preflight
upgrade_recipe: change the Go report before its Swift projection
require an explicit repository root before a Stack Lab read
run stacklab from the selected repository instead of the app home directory
show unknown as incomplete rather than clean
keep every incomplete finding connected to Ma'at evidence
route release-source inspection to Ma'at rather than inventing a Swift release authority
run the native contract and Swift syntax validation before admitted app tests

inputs: direct versioned local Stack Lab recipes and wings
outputs: typed local recipe and wing inventory
inspectable components with source, tests, outputs, writes, and upgrade steps
explicit unreadable or malformed contract evidence
upgrade_recipe: keep local source catalog distinct from remote canonicality
reject and report malformed or non-regular contract records rather than omitting them
add a typed component fixture before extending recipe fields
make every catalog card navigable to its component detail
run catalog tests and the native contract before admitted app tests
